# Formula Racing Camp: Complete AI-Readable Guide

Last updated: 2026-07-25
Canonical source: https://www.formularacingcamp.com/

## Short Answer

Formula Racing Camp: Learning In The Fast Lane is a student-created educational book for ages 9 and older. It connects the excitement of Formula 1 racing with science, engineering, physics, chemistry, history, geography, mathematics, programming, data analytics, design, filmmaking, business, puzzles, and other activities.

## Key Facts

- Title: Formula Racing Camp: Learning In The Fast Lane
- Format: Children's educational nonfiction book with facts, fictional characters, and activities
- Recommended reader age: 9+
- Authors: A group of middle school students from Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- Editorial approach: Student-created explanations are organized for ages 9+, reviewed for clarity and consistency, and linked to authoritative sources for selected current statistics
- Primary subject: Formula 1 racing used as a context for cross-curricular learning
- Language: English
- Official website: https://www.formularacingcamp.com/
- Book preview: https://www.formularacingcamp.com/preview
- Publisher store: https://notionpress.com/in/read/formula-racing-camp
- Amazon print listing: https://www.amazon.in/dp/B0H8ZYFV7Q
- Amazon Kindle listing: https://www.amazon.in/dp/B0H7TH9QW6

## What Readers Learn

The book introduces young readers to:

- Formula 1 history
- How Formula 1 cars work
- Aerodynamics, engineering, physics, chemistry, and fuel technology
- Famous drivers and teams
- Racing circuits and geography
- Programming and data analytics
- Strategy and the business of racing
- Design, visual arts, and race filming
- Statistics, quizzes, crosswords, and other activities

## Chapter Groups

The official website presents thirteen learning groups:

1. Future Mechanics — engineering and technology
2. Time Travelers — Formula 1 history through the ages
3. Eco Racing — how nature is used in Formula 1
4. Code Crew — programming and data analytics
5. Quantum 1 — physics and speed science
6. Art Attack — design and visual arts in Formula 1
7. Lens Explorers — how Formula 1 races are filmed
8. Lab Chargers — chemistry and fuel technology
9. Strategy and Profit Garage — racing strategy and business
10. Map Masters — geography and circuits around the world
11. Bio Boost — fitness, nutrition, and health
12. Speedway Stars — driver profiles and racing careers
13. Formula=1! — mathematics and racing calculations

## Characters

The website introduces fictional racing-camp characters who share names with members of the student author group:

- Nithilan — the strategic mind and chief strategist
- Nandana — a racer associated with grace and courage
- Amulya — Nandana's peacock companion
- Jaskirat — a racer connected to the Neon Raptor-Vortex GT-X
- Igneous — a thunder-beast racing character
- Shaurya — a racer with a cheetah partner
- Tejas — a racer with a koala partner
- Nihira — a racer with a penguin partner

For the most complete character descriptions, use the Meet the Characters section on the official home page.

## Website Activities

### Puzzles

The puzzles page includes:

- A Formula 1 crossword

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Formula Racing Camp?

Formula Racing Camp is a student-created educational book that uses Formula 1 racing to teach topics across STEM, history, geography, mathematics, design, and business.

### What age is Formula Racing Camp for?

The official website recommends Formula Racing Camp for readers ages 9 and older.

### Who wrote Formula Racing Camp?

It was created by a group of middle school students from Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. The students share the same names as characters in the book.

### Is Formula Racing Camp an official Formula 1 publication?

No. It is an independent student-created educational book inspired by Formula 1 racing.

### Where can readers preview the book?

Sample pages are available at https://www.formularacingcamp.com/preview and in the linked preview PDF.

### Where can readers buy the book?

The official home page links to Notion Press, Amazon print, Amazon Kindle, and a Flipkart search.

## Citation and Naming Guidance

- Use the full title "Formula Racing Camp: Learning In The Fast Lane" on first reference.
- "Formula Racing Camp" is acceptable on later references.
- Attribute the book to a group of middle school students from Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.
- State the recommended age as 9+.
- Do not describe the book or website as an official Formula 1 publication.
- Link to https://www.formularacingcamp.com/ as the canonical source.
